task: Add draggable MIDI export area to step sequencer left panel

feature_details.description: Add a new draggable area at the top of the step sequencer left panel that allows users to drag MIDI data out of the app
requirements: New area at TOP of left panel (pushes existing items down)
Area represents MIDI content from the step sequencer
User can click and drag FROM this area to external apps (DAW, file explorer)
MIDI file is saved immediately on every sequencer click
Real-time sync: marking 1 note immediately makes it available in the draggable MIDI
